items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My sister Mary – full sister – taught me how to tap-dance.

ctx.x: Louie, if you could tell us about your siblings. Tell us about your early family recollections.

There were eight children altogether. All the girls came first, and then the boys came second. But the first three girls were from my dad’s first marriage to his wife who came from Italy with him. Those three girls – his wife passed away, so my dad sent to Italy for the sister. When the sister came to America, they had five children: one girl and four boys. So actually Josephine, Dee Dee, and Edie are my half-sisters. Mary is my full sister. And of course the four boys.
Do you remember the names of your brothers?
